issues.title: Conflicting Exit Code Contracts
issues.why: AC-10 defines a strict 5-value exit code contract (0-4), but 03-subcommand-architecture and 07-error-handling explicitly use 'exit 1' for unknown commands and 'exit 1' for batch failures.
issues.fix: Update 03-subcommand-architecture and 07-error-handling to use ExitMisuse (2) for unknown commands and ExitBatchPartial (4) for batch failures.

issues.title: Missing Concurrency/Locking Specs for DB and Files
issues.why: The spec mandates a local SQLite DB and batch execution but lacks instructions on handling concurrent access or file locks during multi-threaded 'exec' or 'update' operations.
issues.fix: Add a 'Concurrency & Locking' section to 10-database.md and 18-batch-execution.md specifying mutex usage or WAL mode for SQLite.

issues.title: Incomplete Acceptance Criteria for Database and Build
issues.why: AC-01 through AC-20 cover most modules, but Phase 5 (Database) and Phase 8 (Build) in the checklist lack corresponding GWT criteria in the 97-acceptance-criteria.md file.
issues.fix: Add AC-21 (Database Persistence) and AC-22 (Build Artifact Integrity) to 97-acceptance-criteria.md.
